ideas.name: Open Source Tenancy
ideas.problem: For teams using open-source databases like ClickHouse, managing multi-tenancy, performance optimization, and data isolation across different clients can be complex and time-consuming.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B with per-instance or per-GB storage pricing, offering managed services and advanced features (e.g., 100 USD/month base + 0.50 USD/GB).
